analysis.summary: Bharat Seats Limited reported strong financial results for FY 2025-26, driven by an increase in car seat sales to Maruti Suzuki India Limited and cost-saving measures. Revenue from operations surged by 51.36% to Rs. 1,95,095.14 lakhs, while net profit after tax grew by 29.15% to Rs. 4,223.12 lakhs. The Board recommended a dividend of 75% (Rs.

capex_expansion.claim: The company started the supply of seats for four wheelers to Maruti Suzuki India Limited from the manufacturing facility set up at Kharkhauda in Sonipat, Haryana starting from April 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: From April 2025, the Company has started supply of seats for four wheelers to Maruti Suzuki India Limited from the manufacturing facility setup at Kharkhauda in Sonipat, Haryana.

capex_expansion.claim: The company initiated a 360 KWp Opex Solar plant implementation under progress expected to be utilized from June 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: 360 KWp Opex Solar plant implementation under progress & will be utilized from Jun-2025.

capex_expansion.claim: A new manufacturing facility is being set up at Kharkhauda, in Sonepat, Haryana.
capex_expansion.quote: A new manufacturing facility is being set up at Kharkhauda, in Sonepat, Haryana.

capex_expansion.claim: Additional production facility is being set up at the company's plant in Bhorakalan, Gurugram, Haryana for the Two-wheeler wheel assembly project for Suzuki Motor Cycle India Private Limited and for new programmes of Maruti Suzuki India Limited.
capex_expansion.quote: Additional production facility is being set up at Company’s plant in Bhorakalan, Gurugram, Haryana for Two-wheeler wheel assembly project for Suzuki Motor Cycle India Private Limited and for new programmes of Maruti Suzuki India Limited.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that there was an increase in sales and profits, but profitability was constrained due to the slow ramp-up of new programmes productionised during the year.
margins_costs.quote: There was increase in sales and profits, but there was inadequacy of profits due to slow ramp up of new programmes productionised during the year.

margins_costs.claim: The company implemented cost reduction and productivity improvement steps to improve profitability.
margins_costs.quote: a. Cost reduction and productivity improvement.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax increased to Rs. 3,270.03 lakhs due to better capacity utilization from increased car seat sales and cost saving measures.
margins_costs.quote: This was due to better capacity utilisation as a result of increase in sales of Car Seats to Maruti Suzuki India Limited and cost saving measures taken by the Company.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of 75% amounting to Rs. 942 lakhs for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Directors are pleased to recommend, for the approval of the shareholders at the 39th Annual General Meeting, a dividend of 75% (Rs.1.50/- per equity share) amounting to Rs.942 lakhs for the financial year ended 31.03.2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The board recommended a dividend of 55% amounting to Rs. 1.10 per equity share for the financial year ended March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Directors are pleased to recommend for the approval of the shareholders at the 38th Annual General Meeting, a dividend of 55% (Rs.1.10/- per equity share) amounting to Rs.690.80 lakhs for the financial year ended 31.03.2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The company issued and allotted 3,14,00,000 bonus equity shares of Rs. 2 each in the proportion of one bonus equity share for every one equity share.
capital_allocation.quote: During the financial year 2024-25, the Company has issued and allotted 3,14,00,000 Bonus Equity shares of Rs.2/- each in proportion of 1(One) Bonus Equity Share for every 1(One)Equity Share(fully paid up).

capital_allocation.claim: The authorised share capital was increased from Rs. 7,00,00,000 to Rs. 15,00,00,000.
capital_allocation.quote: During the financial year 2024-25, Authorised Share Capital of the Company was increased from Rs. 7,00,00,000/- (Rupees Seven Crore), divided into 3,50,00,000 (Three Crore Fifty Lakh) Equity Shares of Rs. 2/- (Rupees Two) each to Rs. 15,00,00,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Crore), divided into 7,50,00,000 (Seven Crore Fifty Lakh) Equity Shares of Rs. 2/- (Rupees Two) each.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company was unable to file form FCGPR for the allotment of bonus shares to foreign nationals or NRIs due to a pendency in registration of an old FCGPR as informed by the AD Bank.
risks_headwinds.quote: b. in respect of the allotment of Bonus shares to foreign nationals/ NRIs, the Company is unable to file form FCGPR. As explained by the management the said filing could not be done as company’s AD Bank has informed the company that there is a pendency in registration of an old FCGPR.

management_commitments.claim: The company proposed the re-appointment of Mr. Rishabh Relan as a Whole Time Director for a period of three years from February 4, 2027 to February 3, 2030.
management_commitments.quote: consent be and is hereby accorded for re-appointment of Mr. Rishabh Relan (DIN: 07726444) as a Whole Time Director for a period of three years with effect from 4th February, 2027 to 3rd February, 2030

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to utilize the 360 KWp Opex Solar plant starting from June 2025.
management_commitments.quote: 360 KWp Opex Solar plant implementation under progress & will be utilized from Jun-2025.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
